text:
Jules: spotting repeated p95 spikes in eu2-dedicated pool since 06:20UTC. Looks like network retransmits + tx queue pile on rack13.
Hannah: pulling tcp_retransmits + nic stats. host-13-04 shows retransmits up 12x, tx_queue_len ~220 for 45s. Kernel shows `NET_RX_DROP` increments.
Marco: Are these hosts behind the new regional egress ACL rollouts? We pushed ACLs last night for peering limits.
Jules: Yes, rack13 is behind the new egress-acl (peering-limiter v2). Could be packet drops causing retries and resulting in NIC queue saturation.
InfraBot: [alert] retransmit-spike@rack13 hosts=[host-13-04,host-13-09] duration=44s severity=medium auto_action=none (dedicated pool)
Hannah: Confirmed drop traces: `iptables` logs show RateLimit REJECTs for a handful of tenant CIDRs. Those tenants are on dedicated slices. ACLs are too strict and causing backpressure.
Marco: Tricky: dedicated tenants shouldn't be silently rate-limited by infra ACL. Options: 1) temporary widen ACL for affected CIDRs, 2) handoff noisy tenant to burst-pool with egress shaper, 3) request tenant to add client-side backoff. Prefer infra-first mitigation to restore p95.
Jules: Widening ACLs now for the affected prefixes, will patch later. Command: `aclctl modify --region eu2 --add-exempt 10.44.12.0/24,10.44.15.0/24 --reason "mitigate retransmit spike"`
Marco: Also spin up ephemeral warm-burst instances and move one noisy tenant as safe fallback. Use preserve-kv to avoid cold starts.
Hannah: Running move: `allocator move-tenant --tenant=analytics-ml --to=burst-warm-eu2 --preserve-kv --note "retransmit mitigation"`
Jules: ACL exception applied. After that retransmits dropped and tx_queue_len drained. p95 went 360ms -> 86ms across rack13 within 2m.
CostOps: FYI burst-warm usage will incur premium. Estimated delta so far: +0.45 GPU-hrs, cost delta ~ $0.60. Billing event queued to tenant account.
Marco: Root cause: peering-limiter v2 had an overly aggressive default for dedicated CIDR ranges. We'll update the deploy checklist and add a canary that ensures dedicated CIDRs get an explicit exception flag.
Hannah: Follow-ups: INFRA-2350 created to add ACL safety check, add alert rule: if tcp_retransmits > 10x AND nic_tx_queue_len > 150 -> recommend ACL review + soft-quarantine path.
InfraBot: Ticket INFRA-2350 created and assigned to netops.
Jules: Leaving burst move active for 25m, will revert when stable. Notifying tenants and ops. Thanks all for fast triage :thumbsup:
Marco: Also proposal: show "egress-acl impact" in console for dedicated pools so owners see when infra-level ACLs may affect them. Adding to INFRA-2350.
Hannah: I'll draft postmortem notes and timeline.
Jules: Closing until next 30m unless regressions.
